configuration.replacement: Uniform old slot independent of new outcome; only selected seller updates
configuration.joint_representation: Exact seller-permutation quotient; correlated rival law preserved
configuration.initial_state: Independent equal mixture of floor(capacity/2),ceil(capacity/2) for odd capacity; exact midpoint for even capacity
configuration.actual_value: Mean seller discounted payoff; equals each seller at exchangeable initialization
configuration.scope: Finite exact-count symmetric oblivious equilibrium; no full-state MPE or uniqueness claim

large_joint_solver.method: Matrix-free exact normalized GMRES with bounded-fill shifted ILU/Sherman-Morrison preconditioning
large_joint_solver.derivative_gauge: Pinned zero derivative at largest positive jump-mass state
large_joint_solver.failure_policy: Explicit failure; no clipping, tolerance relaxation or residual-only stationary acceptance
large_joint_solver.positivity_recovery: Exact lazy Markov propagation of an algebraic candidate until strictly positive; no beliefs before positivity, no clipping or flooring
large_joint_solver.preconditioning: Shifted sparse M-matrix inverse and exact rank-one Sherman-Morrison correction; shift changes only the preconditioner
large_joint_solver.derivative_scaling: Unit-norm right-hand side, then exact rescaling and unchanged pinned backward-error check

independent_stationary_checks.failure_policy: Explicit failure; no tolerance relaxation or residual-only acceptance

sparse_linear_solver.method: Matrix-free normalized GMRES; positive lazy warmup for signed rare tails; no large LU
sparse_linear_solver.derivative_gauge: Pinned zero derivative at largest positive jump-mass state
sparse_linear_solver.failure_policy: Explicit failure; no clipping, tolerance relaxation or residual-only stationary acceptance
sparse_linear_solver.positivity_recovery: Continue the positive initial lazy Markov iterate until the same normalized-system true residual target, then rerun unchanged GMRES; no clipping or flooring

configuration.actual_value_method: Positive calendar Bellman contraction, unchanged discount
configuration.seller_limit: No fixed seller-count limit; explicit exact-quotient state budget
configuration.initial_evaluation: Exact binomial mixture over permutation orbits, O(N)

methods: Subtraction-free sparse positive GTH, reversed elimination order
stationary.scope: Independent finite-chain numerical stability; no mixing-time or uniqueness proof

demand.representation: Exact seller-permutation quotient with correlated joint rival beliefs
demand.quadrature: Positive truncated Gauss-Jacobi; independently doubled order
demand.indexing: Exact colex rank; only the used bounded combinatorial band is stored
demand.orbit_cardinality: Log cardinalities; displayed float sizes never enter economic calculations

seed.method: Same-capacity verified policy from the previous seller count
